name: And I saw the stars falling down...
source:
In an empty theatre, a woman narrates the story of a family and the abuse behind. Everyone tries to convince you it's not their fault... but you don't know who to believe. You can't even trust the narrator.

[i]Especially the narrator.[/i]

A free visual novel about a family and domestic violence.
The characters will try to argue the situation is not their fault or that it's not really that important, and it's up to the reader to find out what really happened.

[from [url=https://dmeow.itch.io/and-i-saw-the-stars-falling-down]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在空无一人的剧院里，一名女子讲述了一个家庭的故事以及背后的虐待。每个人都试图说服你这不是他们的错……但你不知道该相信谁。你甚至不能相信叙述者。

[i]尤其是叙述者。[/i]

一部关于家庭和家庭暴力的免费视觉小说。
角色们会试图辩称这种情况不是他们的错，或者事情并不那么重要，而要由读者来找出到底发生了什么。

[来自[url=https://dmeow.itch.io/and-i-saw-the-stars-falling-down]itch.io[/url]]
